# Monahan Chiropractic

Monahan Chiropractic is a family-owned, family-run chiropractic practice in Encinitas, California, in continuous operation for over 35 years.

## About
- Family owned and operated since the practice's founding; several generations of the Monahan family have worked in the office, including grandchildren today.
- Dr. Monahan is also a professor of anatomy, physiology, and biology at Palomar College.
- The practice treats patients across generations, from young children to grandparents, often multiple members of the same family.

## Services
- Spinal adjustments
- Family and pediatric chiropractic care
- Sports and active lifestyle care
- Prenatal chiropractic support

## Practical information
- Location: Encinitas, California
- Phone: (760) 634-0232
- Most major insurance plans accepted
- No referral required for a first visit
- Hours: Monday, Wednesday, Friday 9:00am–1:00pm and 3:00–5:30pm; Tuesday 10:00am–3:00pm; closed Thursday, Saturday, and Sunday
